apps.name: Ethical Games Installer
apps.game: Installs and updates the test builds
apps.notes: First test build: lists every Ethical game, installs and updates them (and itself), checks each download's size and SHA-256, and offers to remove old test builds.

apps.name: Ethical Solitaire
apps.notes: New look: Cyber Neon (Menu › Look) — glowing neon cards on black crushed velvet, neon icons and menus. Optional; the default look is unchanged.

apps.name: Ethical FreeCell
apps.notes: New look: the menu is the ≡ button and holds New game; Undo and Hint are icons (hold one to see its name). New app ID app.ethicalgames.freecell — remove the old test build if you had one.
